<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def hud(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(64) if a[r][62]=='W')
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
# Find remaining white cells in right grid
white_cells=[(r,c) for r in range(49,64) for c in range(18,35) if a[r][c]=='W']
print("remaining white cells:", white_cells)
# Click one cell from each white block
# Group by proximity
blocks=[]
for r,c in white_cells:
    placed=False
    for b in blocks:
        if abs(r-b[-1][0])<=3 and abs(c-b[-1][1])<=3:
            b.append((r,c)); placed=True; break
    if not placed:
        blocks.append([(r,c)])
print("white blocks:", [(b[0], len(b)) for b in blocks])
# Click center of each block
for b in blocks:
    r=sum(x[0] for x in b)//len(b)
    c=sum(x[1] for x in b)//len(b)
    print(f"Clicking ({r},{c})")
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}],intent='explore')
    print(f"  hudW {hud(current_frame)} level {current_frame.level} done {last_action_result.get('done')} level_completed {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        break
# Check final state
a2=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
white2=[(r,c) for r in range(49,64) for c in range(18,35) if a2[r][c]=='W']
green2=[(r,c) for r in range(49,64) for c in range(18,35) if a2[r][c]=='N']
print("white after:", len(white2), "green after:", len(green2))

def hud(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(64) if a[r][62]=='W')

# Group by proximity
blocks=[]
for r,c in white_cells:
    placed=False
    for b in blocks:
